mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months reduces the real discount rate applied to future equity valuations, thereby depressing the present value of expected future cash flows and driving negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains >4.5% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive during the identified FEDFUNDS tightening phase, or FEDFUNDS reverts below 4.5% without a subsequent return to negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in PAYEMS (labor market tightness) above 135,000 indicates reduced labor market slack, which raises wage growth expectations and accelerates corporate investment, producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 135,000 and remains >135,000 for the next 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during the identified labor market tightening phase (p > 0.05 two-tailed test).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 (goods demand) grows at an annualized rate exceeding 4% for two consecutive quarters, it signals robust consumer and business demand, which elevates equity risk premia and yields negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly log growth > 0.08 (4% annualized) for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: During the identified late-cycle demand expansion, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both INDPRO (industrial production) and RSAFS (retail sales) by at least 2% in the same month suggests supply-side softness that reduces economic momentum and produces negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < prev and RSAFS < prev, both by >=2% in the same month
failure_condition: During supply shock episodes, the 5-day forward return is not negative (i.e., non-negative) in >70% of occurrences.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 4% for three consecutive months in a non-recessionary regime, it indicates persistent monetary easing that lowers real rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 4% for three consecutive months and regime is not 'recessionary'
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the identified easing period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4% accompanied by a 10% one-month increase in HOUST (housing starts) suggests a shift toward labor market slack and construction optimism, which can drive positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4% and HOUST increases by >10% in the following month
regime_hint: labor market softening with construction rebound
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during the identified labor softening with construction rebound (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (production) exceeding 2% each for two months indicate a dual softening in demand and supply, which amplifies economic deceleration and produces negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < prev by >2% and INDPRO < prev by >2% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: During dual softening episodes, 20-day forward returns are not negative in >50% of cases (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime-specific effect: during a FEDFUNDS rise above 5.25% for three consecutive months in a recessionary regime, the increased policy rate raises real borrowing costs, suppressing equity risk appetite and generating negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains >5.25% for three consecutive months and regime is 'recessionary'
failure_condition: During the identified tightening in a recession, the 5-day forward return is not negative (i.e., non-negative) in >80% of occurrences.
